title: Scale interactive galaxy markers and defer heavy planet/surface code
research_summary: Scale the V2 universe without inventing a custom loader or picking engine. Use React.lazy + Suspense for PlanetScene and SurfaceScene so the heavy procedural-planet/terrain code is fetched only on first entry. Remove the now-unused live PlanetPass from the always-on cinematic composer because orbit planets use the package-supported bakePlanet path. Batch procedural system markers into one THREE.Points object and rely on Three Raycaster Points.threshold plus R3F pointer events for picking, increasing explorable deterministic systems without one mesh/draw-call per marker.

sources.finding: React.lazy defers a component's code until it is first rendered; Suspense provides the loading boundary and the dynamic import result is cached.
THREE.Raycaster supports Points objects and exposes params.Points.threshold in world units for point-picking precision.
React Three Fiber exposes pointer/click events for Three objects that implement raycast, forwarding Three intersection data through its event system.
bakePlanet returns ordinary meshes and is explicitly recommended for distant planets, dozens of background bodies and mobile; live PlanetRenderer is reserved for close/live effects.

candidates.name: React.lazy + Suspense
candidates.reason: Native React solution for splitting heavy PlanetScene and SurfaceScene chunks; no custom loader required.

candidates.name: THREE.Points + Raycaster threshold + R3F events
candidates.reason: One GPU points object can carry hundreds of procedural system markers while remaining clickable through built-in raycasting and R3F events.

candidates.name: One Mesh per procedural system
candidates.reason: Simple but scales draw calls linearly and is unnecessary because Points already supports picking.

candidates.name: Custom asset loader / manual chunk registry
candidates.reason: React.lazy and the bundler already solve component-level on-demand loading.

candidates.name: Always-on PlanetRenderer/PlanetPass
candidates.reason: The current close-up path now uses bakePlanet; keeping live PlanetRenderer in the initial galaxy bundle adds shader/runtime cost with no active live Planet.

selected: procedural-planets bakePlanet as deferred planet renderer
decision.fallback: Keep catalog and Hero markers as individual meshes for stronger visual affordance; only procedural markers are batched.
